cues.text: The aircraft bounced a second time, the nose over rotating upwards. It was at this point that I took firm hold of the yoke and pushed forward. As the aircraft reached the crest of the bounce I pulled all the way back on the yoke. The aircraft touched down the third time and stayed on the ground.
